en.text:
Scoring a Kill with any weapon grants Master of Arms x1, granting 15% increased damage for #e${7+#d} seconds.

Scoring a Kill with any weapon with Master of Arms active grants Master of Arms x2, granting 25% increased damage for #e${4+#d} seconds.

Master of Arms x2 expiring reverts the buff back to Master of Arms x1.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
)
